title: API config design scratchpad (personal notes)
content:
Quick personal sketch for an API + config shape for per-route model/runtime config. Mostly rough - for discussion with Jamie/Casey.

Purpose:
- Capture the minimal shape we need for route-level config (model variant, quantization profile, batching, caching, fallback policies, rollout).
- Keep it flexible: used by hosted API, dedicated, and private control planes.

Notes / constraints:
- Config must be small (few KB) and mergeable with defaults.
- Versioned (semver-ish) so we can roll forward/back.
- Support partial updates (PATCH) and a preview endpoint that computes effective config.

API sketch (CRUD):
- GET /v1/routes/{route_id}/config -> returns effective config + raw override
- PATCH /v1/routes/{route_id}/config -> partial update (merge semantics)
- POST /v1/routes/{route_id}/config/preview -> input overrides -> returns diff + estimated cost/latency impact
- GET /v1/models/{model_id}/profiles -> model capabilities (max_seq, supported_quant, perf_profiles)

Example config payload (informal):
{
  "route_id": "checkout-recommendations",
  "config_version": "0.1.0",
  "model": {
    "name": "redwood-open-1",
    "variant": "q4_0",
    "pin_version": "2025-01-10"
  },
  "inference": {
    "max_tokens": 512,
    "temperature": 0.0,
    "batching": {
      "mode": "auto",        // off | fixed | auto
      "min_batch_size": 1,
      "max_batch_latency_ms": 12
    },
    "kv_cache": {
      "enabled": true,
      "ttl_seconds": 3600
    }
  },
  "routing": {
    "primary_tier": "dedicated", // hosted | dedicated | private
    "fallbacks": ["hosted-small", "hosted-large"],
    "region_affinity": ["us-west-2"]
  },
  "fallback_policy": {
    "on_capacity_exhausted": "failover", // failover | queue | reject
    "on_model_error": "graceful_degrade"
  },
  "telemetry": {
    "sampling_rate": 0.01,
    "capture_kv_cache_hits": true
  },
  "rollout": {
    "strategy": "canary", // canary | a_b | gradual | immediate
    "percent": 10,
    "duration_minutes": 60
  }
}

Questions / TODOs:
- Should batching.policy be declarative (optimizer does tuning) or fully prescriptive? I think default: auto with hints (target_p50_latency, max_cost_per_1k_tokens).
- How do we express quantization fallback? e.g., allow server to pick a higher-precision variant if q4 causes accuracy regression for this route. Maybe model.allow_lower_precision: true/false + degrade_threshold (WER/metric).
- Preview endpoint must surface estimated throughput/cost. Need a compact perf profile model for each model-variant. Link to perf_profile idea in Confluence (CONFLUENCE-API-CONF-42).

Operational notes:
- Validate config on write (schema + semantic checks) but allow save as draft.
- Keep an audit trail: who changed, previous_version, commit message.
- Support lint/ci checks from GitHub PRs (link PR to config id).

ASCII architecture sketch (very rough):

 client -> edge gateway -> config-eval (merge default + overrides) -> routing decision -> runtime pool (dedicated/hosted/private)
                                      |
                                      v
                              preview/cost-estimator (perf profiles + telemetry)

Edge cases to think about:
- Cross-region routing: what happens if region_affinity conflicts with dedicated-only model? return warning + previewed degrade plan.
- Private deployments: config write should create a signed config blob that customer control plane can consume (no PII in config).
- Conflicting rollouts: two simultaneous rollouts for same route (prevent via optimistic lock/version).

Small checklist before team sync:
- [ ] Formalize schema (JSON Schema) + example generator script (python).
- [ ] Add preview endpoint spec (inputs/outputs + sample)
- [ ] Define perf_profile compact representation (p50/p95 tokens/sec, cost_per_1k)
- [ ] Discuss quantization/fallback semantics with applied-ml (ask Casey)

Refs / links (scratch):
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-API-CONF-42 (perf profile + config mental model)
- Jira: JIRA-INF-789 (route-level config epic)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/812 (initial config API scaffolding)

Notes-to-self: keep this doc informal. Bring to sync w/ Jamie + Casey next Tue. Mark any fields that must be encrypted (e.g., kms keys, not present here).

End of scratchpad.
